turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend per order; the closest are ad_spend_eur and orders_total filtered on order status. For 1-30 September 2026, ad spend (EUR) was 6,270.0 EUR, and orders were 60 placed and 50 shipped (10 cancelled excluded). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
